en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing two early electric trams (car no. 407 and another behind it) stopped on a cobblestone road in front of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. Many people in period clothing, including children and uniformed officials, stand around the trams. German shop signs line the façades (for a jeweler, drapery, bicycle shop, etc.). Leafless trees and a decorative street lamp are visible on the right, and a sign for a confectioner hangs on the corner.
